title: cocode.run (event)
description: Run pressed (Ctrl+Enter) and the window could not run it on this machine itself: the program has lines that reach outside the sandbox (reach: ping, claude.browser, research, $ cmd…), the engine has no local runner (or it is off), the build is missing, still building or in a language the runner does not run here, the human chose Not now on the consent card, or the runner was busy or the language unavailable (the same run id then carries a system line saying so). With reach, you are the interpreter: perform each reach for real with your own tools, in the program's order, and stream what happened. Otherwise run the build if build.rev equals rev, or build for this rev first; stream cocode.output with this run id and close it with done:true. A window that ran it itself sends cocode.ran instead.

run.description: The window's id for this run: r_<rev>_<n>.

truncated.description: true when text was longer than 64 000 characters; the tail is kept.

reach.description: The lines that reach outside the sandbox, by line (present only when there are any). Each is a call the sandbox cannot perform: do it for real with the matching tool, in order, and stream the real result.

kind.description: net: ping, dns, fetch, curl, requests… · browser: claude.browser(url), browse, screenshot · search: a web search · research: a research agent · agent: a sub-agent · hermes: the local Hermes agent · shell: a command · say: a chat line · ask: a question · claude: any other claude.<verb>(…).

name.description: The verb as written: ping, claude.browser, requests, $ (a shell line).

args.description: The call's arguments as written, outer quotes stripped; the rest of the line for the pseudo-code form (ping google.com); empty for a library call.

build.description: The latest build if there is one, stale or not (build.rev < rev means stale).

code.description: The real program. May be empty while status is building or failed.

source.description: claude: your cocode.build. local: the editor's text, as written.

rev.description: Document revision; starts at 1 and never goes down.

lang.description: Free text, 1-24 characters: python, js, my-lang, pseudo.
